description: The completed residual-geometry pilot, treated as a frozen reference. This package reproduces its numbers before extending it. The reference outputs are read only; nothing is written back to them.

reference_run.estimator: an in-house L2 logistic regression minimising the scikit-learn LogisticRegression objective by L-BFGS-B, because scikit-learn was not installed in that environment

estimator_tolerances.note: the reference deliberately converged an order of magnitude tighter than scikit-learn's default tol=1e-04, and recorded that it had done so. Reproduction must set tol=1e-06 to compare like with like; at the scikit-learn default the two differ by 6.3e-05 at state 45 purely because lbfgs stopped earlier.

reference_run.why_reproduced: the pilot's estimator, folds, metrics and PCA were all hand-written; this package re-derives the same numbers with scikit-learn so that every later result rests on a standard implementation

layerwise_metrics.note: the pilot's 'layer' column is this package's 'state'; values 0-48 are identical in meaning

fold_assignment_and_out_of_fold_scores.note: the only serialised record of the pilot's fold assignment, and its out-of-fold scores at the selected state

degenerate_state_expectation.reason: the rendered chat prompt ends with the same token for every prompt, so the embedding output is one identical vector across all rows; a probe there is pinned to chance by construction

reproduction_tolerance.reference_recorded_precision: six decimal places, so a reference value carries up to 5e-07 of rounding error before any estimator difference is considered; a residual difference below that is the file's own rounding and not a disagreement
reproduction_tolerance.gate: state 45 must agree within the tolerance using the pilot's own fold assignment
reproduction_tolerance.reported: the maximum absolute difference over all 49 states and all compared metrics

known_limitations_of_the_reference: the selected state was chosen by maximising out-of-fold performance over all 49 states on the same rows the score is reported from, so the reported peak is a selected maximum and is optimistically biased
the permutation null was computed only at the already-selected state and does not repeat the 49-state search, so it does not price the selection
an activation-norm control reached ROC-AUC 0.871, so a large part of the separability is magnitude rather than direction, and no unit-normalised probe was run
folds were built by a bespoke round-robin deal, not by sklearn.model_selection.StratifiedKFold, so an independent stratified split will not reproduce the numbers
out-of-fold predictions were saved for the selected state only
no prompt-family grouping was available, so folds are label-stratified only

committed_artifact.note: Phase 2 step 5: both reference files are now committed artifacts of this repository and are resolved from it, not from configs/paths.local.json. Their SHA256 values are unchanged and are still checked before use.
committed_artifact.data_root_backup: frozen/pilot_reference/ under the machine-local data root; a frozen backup, not a runtime input
